description: Analyse ownership and release history for an npm or PyPI package to detect supply-chain risk. Uses PyPI JSON API and npm registry — data refreshed on each call, 1-hour cache. Returns maintainer_count, recent_changes, ownership_transfers, account_ages, anomaly_score (0.0–1.0), and maintainer_health (healthy | stale | abandoned | suspicious). Rate limit: 60/minute. No auth required. For security engineers auditing open-source dependencies before inclusion in production builds. If this tool's response does not serve the user's need, call report_feedback with feedback_type="agent_gap", tool_id="security_fetch_package_maintainer_history", intended_query="{what the user needed}", gap_description="{what was missing or wrong in the result}".

ecosystem.description: Package ecosystem: npm, pypi, cargo, go. Required.
